entries.058cf1f73d0be6b6: This business consists of ceramic packages and organic substrates (packages, boards) for protecting and connecting semiconductors. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (including intersegment transactions) was ¥379,432 million, up 16.0% from ¥327,049 million in the previous year. It is the largest business within Core Components.
entries.1fd36a06197b8dca: This business is built on the fine ceramics technology carried on since the company's founding and involves core components of equipment. It makes various fine ceramic components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, in-vehicle camera modules, and ceramic and organic packages that protect electronic components and ICs, for the semiconductor, industrial machinery, automotive-related and information and communications markets. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥652,597 million, accounting for 31.5% of the total. Business profit for the same year was ¥63,082 million, a substantial improvement from a loss of ¥1,889 million in the previous year. The company attributes the main reason for the revenue increase to growth in ceramic packages for information and communications-related markets and organic packages for data centers.
entries.4995a631d8cfa67a: A business of office printers and multifunction devices, commercial and industrial inkjet printers, and document solutions services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including intersegment transactions, was ¥478,479 million, the largest of the solutions businesses. It is carried out by KYOCERA Document Solutions Inc., Germany's TA Triumph-Adler GmbH and others.
entries.4a55bd2fbdf58a40: A segment that groups businesses which deliver machines and services themselves to customers, rather than components. It includes the Machine Tools Business, which handles cutting tools and pneumatic and electric tools for the automotive, general industrial and construction markets; the Document Solutions Business, which handles office printers and multifunction devices, document management systems, and commercial and industrial printers; the Communication Business, which handles communication terminals, communication solutions services, ICT solutions and engineering services; and other businesses, such as smart energy-related products and services and electricity sales. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,044,452 million, roughly half of consolidated revenue of ¥2,070,203 million, making it the largest business. Operating profit for the same year was ¥103,943 million.
entries.a9e226d391bc25df: It includes medical devices, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (including intersegment transactions) was ¥23,928 million. Medical devices are handled by Kyocera Medical Corporation.
entries.b33caa2052249a74: It includes smart energy-related products and services, the electricity sales business, printing devices, jewelry and applied products, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (including intersegment transactions) was ¥87,346 million, up 16.4% from ¥75,030 million in the previous year.
entries.b4f637f0c51ae9b9: A Kyoto-based comprehensive manufacturer that, building on fine ceramics technology, makes products ranging from semiconductor packages and electronic components to cutting tools, multifunction printers, and communications equipment.
entries.cad981e6f911255e: This is a business not included in the three reporting segments. The securities report explains that it mainly consists of the GaN (gallium nitride) device business and research and development expenses that are not allocated to any segment. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,508 million, and business loss was ¥41,168 million. Research and development expenses of ¥36,194 million for the same year are included in this category, and these expenses largely account for the size of the loss.
entries.d5b53fd88766248b: A business of cutting tools for automobiles, general industry and construction markets, pneumatic and electric tools, and products that help improve the working environment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including intersegment transactions, was ¥285,936 million, down 6.5% from ¥305,876 million in the previous year. The company explains that the main reason for this decline was the transfer of its U.S. subsidiary Kyocera Industrial Tools, Inc. in January 2026.
entries.e8900d2471c2334f: This business makes and sells electronic components and devices, such as capacitors, crystal components, connectors, and sensor and control components, for the information and communications, industrial machinery, automotive-related and consumer markets. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥362,646 million, accounting for 17.5% of the total. Business profit for the same year was ¥7,316 million, an improvement from a loss of ¥818 million in the previous year. The company attributes the revenue increase to higher sales of capacitors and other products for automotive and information and communications-related markets by the Kyocera AVX Components Corporation group in the United States.
entries.f029af919e7d2c41: This business consists of fine ceramic components, in-vehicle systems (in-vehicle camera modules, displays), and optical components. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (including intersegment transactions) was ¥250,069 million.
entries.fe70ce14ab27a83a: A business of communication terminals and communication solutions services, ICT solutions and engineering services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including intersegment transactions, was ¥219,158 million. It is carried out by KYOCERA CORPORATION and KYOCERA Communication Systems Co., Ltd.
